0022600197.text: The Detroit Pistons, 6-2 and first in the Central and second in the East, host the Los Angeles Lakers in the Pistons' ninth game of the 2026-27 season, coming off a loss in their most recent outing. The Lakers are also 6-2, sitting first in the Pacific and third in the West, and they arrive on a two-game winning streak with a 4-1 home record. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), both listed as out, and the teams have not yet met this season, though the Pistons won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 113-110 win in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
